stories.title: Office Space's Richard Riehle dies at 78
stories.summary: Richard Riehle, the character actor who played Tom Smykowski in Office Space, died at 78 the previous week, TMZ reported on Oct 19 and his reps confirmed. The tributes came in his character's own lines: "I have people skills!," a pile of jokes about not wanting to jump to conclusions, and clips of his "I deal with the goddamn customers" scene. TMZ's post got 28K likes, "Office Space" and "Richard Riehle" both trended on X, and his Wikipedia page drew 98K views that day. The same day, Dylan Sprouse's "dad coded hollering" video of Barbara Palvin's runway walk was spreading, along with a Chinese dissident's claim that Kim Jong Un had died, which was false.
